preconditions.description: The number of destinations n is between 2 and 10^5 inclusive.
The number of corridors m is between n-1 and 10^6 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= n and 1 <= b <= n and a != b for a, b, e in corridors)
preconditions.description: Each corridor connects two distinct destinations a and b, both between 1 and n inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= e <= 10**9 for a, b, e in corridors)
preconditions.description: The energy requirement e for each corridor is between 0 and 10^9 inclusive.
The number of corridor entries matches the specified m.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly m lines, one for each corridor.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= e_max <= 10**9 for e_max in output)
postconditions.description: Each E_max(c_i) is between 0 and 10^9 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(e_max == max(e for e in energies if is_critical_edge(a, b, e, output)) for (a, b, _), e_max in zip(corridors, output))
postconditions.description: Each E_max(c_i) is the largest energy e such that changing the energy requirement of c_i to e would still make it part of a minimum spanning tree.
